an5.111:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato kulupako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca
an5.111:1.3: asanthavavissāsī ca hoti anissaravikappī ca byatthupasevī ca upakaṇṇakajappī ca atiyācanako ca
an5.111:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kulupako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
an5.111:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato kulupako bhikkhu kulesu piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca
an5.111:2.3: na asanthavavissāsī ca hoti na anissaravikappī ca na byatthupasevī ca na upakaṇṇakajappī ca na atiyācanako ca
an5.111:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kulupako bhikkhu kulesu piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cāti.
